scope: Recorded 1,000-step pi0.5 runs; not a matched framework benchmark. GPU model and complete resolved configurations are not recorded in the scalar exports.

methodology.gpu_utilization: Arithmetic mean of approximately 1.5-second polls through last training iteration; includes startup after effective-batch marker and intervening validation/reporting. Native end is estimated by subtracting final save duration from its timestamp. One logged device per run.
methodology.throughput: Harmonic mean of equal-size logged windows. Native: nine 100-step windows after step 0; Ray: ten 100-step windows including periodic validation/checkpoint/reporting time.
methodology.phase_timing: Native: window averages excluding startup; Ray: 100 individual iterations sampled every ten steps. Compute timer boundaries differ between implementations.
methodology.elapsed_time: Relative to effective-batch scalar, after model/data setup, not job launch.
